313    @classmethod
314    def evaluate(
315        cls,
316        task: TaskSpec,
317        planned_actions: List[str],
318        change_summary: str = "",
319        reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None,
320        verification: Optional[VerificationPlan] = None,
321        hygiene_policy: Optional[PolicyEvaluationResult] = None,
322        non_independent_roles: Optional[List[str]] = None,
323    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
324        """
325        Determines whether the post-verification task hits a human authority boundary.
326        Distinguishes quality improvements (autonomously permitted) from debt acceptance / weakening.
327        """
328        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
329            objective=task.objective,
330            repo_name=task.repository,
331            planned_actions=planned_actions,
332            human_approval_requirements=task.human_approval_requirements,
333        )
334        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]
335
336        if task.human_approval_requirements:
337            for req in task.human_approval_requirements:
338                if req in HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS and req not in triggers:
339                    triggers.append(req)
340
341        if hygiene_policy:
342            if hygiene_policy.is_hard_rejected and "hygiene_policy_violation" not in triggers:
343                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_violation")
344            if hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.DEBT_ACCEPTANCE and "slop_debt_acceptance" not in triggers:
345                triggers.append("slop_debt_acceptance")
346            elif hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.WEAKENING and "hygiene_policy_weakening" not in triggers:
347                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_weakening")
348            elif hygiene_policy.verdict == PolicyChangeType.UNKNOWN and "security_policy_exception" not in triggers:
349                triggers.append("security_policy_exception")
350        else:
351            actions_str = " ".join(planned_actions).lower()
352            if "tombstone" in actions_str and "slop_debt_acceptance" not in triggers:
353                triggers.append("slop_debt_acceptance")
354            if "ceiling increase" in actions_str and "hygiene_policy_violation" not in triggers:
355                triggers.append("hygiene_policy_violation")
356
357        # 4. Inspect reconciliation findings for unresolved blockers or security human reviews
358        if reconciliation and reconciliation.requires_human_judgment:
359            if "security_policy_exception" not in triggers:
360                triggers.append("security_policy_exception")
361
362        # A change whose reviewer was its own author has not been independently
363        # reviewed, however clean the verdict reads. On HOWLFRAM-BUG-50 failover
364        # handed the implementer three of its own reviews and the run proceeded
365        # as though independence held, so this now reaches the human either way.
366        if non_independent_roles and "non_independent_review" not in triggers:
367            triggers.append("non_independent_review")
368
369        # 5. Critical risk tasks always trigger human authority
370        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
371            triggers.append("production_deployment")
372
373        if not triggers:
374            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
375
376        # Build decision packet
377        evidence_list: List[str] = []
378        if verification:
379            for step in verification.steps:
380                evidence_list.append(f"Step '{step.name}': {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code})")
381
382        if hygiene_policy and hygiene_policy.changes:
383            for c in hygiene_policy.changes:
384                evidence_list.append(f"Policy Change [{c.change_type.value.upper()}]: {c.description}")
385
386        risks_list: List[str] = []
387        for t in triggers:
388            risks_list.append(f"Policy boundary '{t}': {HUMAN_BOUNDARY_TRIGGERS.get(t, t)}")
389
390        findings_summary = {
391            "total": len(reconciliation.findings) if reconciliation else 0,
392            "blocker": reconciliation.unresolved_blockers if reconciliation else 0,
393            "high": reconciliation.unresolved_highs if reconciliation else 0,
394        }
395
396        rec_action = "Review diff and evidence packet, then provide explicit approval or rejection."
397        if "hygiene_policy_violation" in triggers:
398            rec_action = "HARD REJECT: Prohibited ceiling inflation or policy violation must be remediated in code."
399
400        summary_text = change_summary
401        if not summary_text and hygiene_policy:
402            summary_text = hygiene_policy.summary
403        if not summary_text:
404            summary_text = "Pending review & human confirmation."
405
406        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
407            objective=task.objective,
408            repo_name=task.repository,
409            planned_actions=planned_actions,
410            human_approval_requirements=triggers,
411        )
412        executor_id = actions[0].executor_id if actions and actions[0].executor_id else None
413
414        packet = HumanDecisionPacket(
415            task_id=task.task_id,
416            objective=task.objective,
417            change_summary=summary_text,
418            boundary_triggers=triggers,
419            evidence=evidence_list,
420            risks=risks_list,
421            review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
422            verification_status=verification.overall_status if verification else "unverified",
423            recommended_action=rec_action,
424            proposed_actions=[a.to_dict() for a in actions],
425            executor_id=executor_id,
426        )
427
428        return BoundaryCheckResult(
429            requires_human_approval=True,
430            triggered_boundaries=triggers,
431            decision_packet=packet,
432        )
433
434    @classmethod
435    def evaluate_with_delegated_authority(
436        cls,
437        task: TaskSpec,
438        planned_actions: List[str],
439        envelope: Optional[Any] = None,
440        target_repo: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
441        repo_slug: Optional[str] = None,
442        files_changed: Optional[List[str]] = None,
443        **kwargs: Any,
444    ) -> BoundaryCheckResult:
445        """
446        Delegated-authority pre-check (#59 Phase 11): ProposedAction ->
447        identify authority class -> does the campaign's AuthorityEnvelope
448        contain exact permission? If every triggered boundary resolves to
449        DELEGATED_AUTHORITY_ALLOW, autonomous continuation is permitted
450        without asking a human. Otherwise this falls through to today's
451        evaluate_pre_execution()/evaluate() behavior unchanged -- this
452        method never weakens or replaces existing human-boundary protection,
453        it only adds a policy-driven allow path in front of it.
454
455        The model never answers "am I allowed?" here: the only inputs that
456        matter are the envelope (operator-created, tamper-verified) and the
457        NEVER_DELEGATABLE_BOUNDARIES set (code-defined, not campaign data).
458        """
459        # Local imports to avoid a hard import-time dependency from
460        # human_boundary.py (a foundational, widely-imported module) on the
461        # newer authority modules, and to keep this delegated-authority path
462        # entirely optional for callers that don't pass an envelope.
463        from howlplane.control_plane.authority_envelope import (
464            AuthorityDecision,
465            evaluate_action_against_envelope,
466        )
467        from howlplane.control_plane.proposed_action import infer_proposed_actions_from_diff
468
469        repo_name = task.repository or (Path(target_repo).name if target_repo else "")
470        actions = infer_proposed_actions(
471            objective=task.objective,
472            repo_name=repo_name,
473            planned_actions=planned_actions,
474            human_approval_requirements=task.human_approval_requirements,
475        )
476        actions = actions + infer_proposed_actions_from_diff(files_changed or [], repo_name=repo_name)
477
478        triggers = [a.authority_boundary for a in actions if a.authority_boundary]
479        if task.risk_level == "critical" and "production_deployment" not in triggers:
480            triggers.append("production_deployment")
481
482        if not triggers:
483            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False)
484
485        slug = repo_slug or repo_name
486        all_delegated = True
487        reasons: List[str] = []
488        for trigger in triggers:
489            if trigger in NEVER_DELEGATABLE_BOUNDARIES:
490                all_delegated = False
491                reasons.append(f"'{trigger}' is never delegatable regardless of envelope contents.")
492                continue
493            decision, reason = evaluate_action_against_envelope(envelope, trigger, slug)
494            if decision != AuthorityDecision.DELEGATED_AUTHORITY_ALLOW:
495                all_delegated = False
496            reasons.append(reason)
497
498        if all_delegated:
499            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False, triggered_boundaries=triggers)
500
501        # Not fully delegated: build the human decision packet directly from
502        # the triggers already computed above (which may include diff-based
503        # self-modification triggers that evaluate_pre_execution()'s own
504        # text-only inference would never see) rather than re-deriving
505        # triggers from scratch and silently losing them.
506        return cls._build_pre_execution_packet(
507            task, triggers, actions,
508            change_summary="Consequential action requested; delegated authority did not fully cover it.",
509            evidence=["Delegated authority evaluation: " + "; ".join(reasons)],
510            risk_prefix="Boundary",
511        )

Evaluates task intent, actions, and risk against human authority policies.

499            return BoundaryCheckResult(requires_human_approval=False, triggered_boundaries=triggers)
500
501        # Not fully delegated: build the human decision packet directly from
502        # the triggers already computed above (which may include diff-based
503        # self-modification triggers that evaluate_pre_execution()'s own
504        # text-only inference would never see) rather than re-deriving
505        # triggers from scratch and silently losing them.
506        return cls._build_pre_execution_packet(
507            task, triggers, actions,
508            change_summary="Consequential action requested; delegated authority did not fully cover it.",
509            evidence=["Delegated authority evaluation: " + "; ".join(reasons)],
510            risk_prefix="Boundary",
511        )

Delegated-authority pre-check (#59 Phase 11): ProposedAction -> identify authority class -> does the campaign's AuthorityEnvelope contain exact permission? If every triggered boundary resolves to DELEGATED_AUTHORITY_ALLOW, autonomous continuation is permitted without asking a human. Otherwise this falls through to today's evaluate_pre_execution()/evaluate() behavior unchanged -- this method never weakens or replaces existing human-boundary protection, it only adds a policy-driven allow path in front of it.

The model never answers "am I allowed?" here: the only inputs that matter are the envelope (operator-created, tamper-verified) and the NEVER_DELEGATABLE_BOUNDARIES set (code-defined, not campaign data).

def compute_repository_fingerprint( repo_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path], task_run_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None) -> RepositoryStateFingerprint: 
581def compute_repository_fingerprint(
582    repo_dir: Union[str, Path],
583    task_run_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
584) -> RepositoryStateFingerprint:
585    """
586    Computes a cryptographic fingerprint of the repository state bound to this task.
587    Uses git HEAD commit SHA, status porcelain, and attributable diff content.
588    """
589    root = Path(repo_dir).resolve()
590    res_sha = run_git_in_repo(root, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
591    commit_sha = res_sha.stdout.strip() if res_sha.returncode == 0 else "HEAD_UNKNOWN"
592
593    res_status = run_git_in_repo(root, ["status", "--porcelain"])
594    status_out = res_status.stdout if res_status.returncode == 0 else ""
595    dirty = bool(status_out.strip())
596
597    files: List[str] = []
598    for line in status_out.splitlines():
599        if line.strip():
600            path_part = line[3:].strip()
601            if " -> " in path_part:
602                path_part = path_part.split(" -> ")[1].strip()
603            if (
604                path_part.startswith(".task_runs")
605                or path_part.startswith(".howlchangeops")
606                or path_part.startswith("logs/control_plane")
607                or path_part.endswith(".jsonl")
608            ):
609                continue
610            files.append(path_part)
611
612    diff_text = ""
613    if task_run_dir and (Path(task_run_dir) / "baseline.json").is_file():
614        try:
615            from howlplane.control_plane.git_baseline import capture_delta, GitBaseline
616            baseline_data = json.loads((Path(task_run_dir) / "baseline.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
617            baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(baseline_data)
618            delta = capture_delta(root, baseline)
619            diff_text = delta.diff_content
620        except Exception:
621            pass
622
623    if not diff_text:
624        res_diff = run_git_in_repo(root, ["diff", "HEAD"])
625        diff_text = res_diff.stdout if res_diff.returncode == 0 else ""
626        for f_name in sorted(files):
627            f_path = root / f_name
628            if f_path.is_file():
629                try:
630                    diff_text += f"\n--- {f_name} ---\n" + f_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
631                except Exception:
632                    pass
633
634    diff_sha256 = hashlib.sha256(diff_text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
635    return RepositoryStateFingerprint(
636        commit_sha=commit_sha,
637        dirty=dirty,
638        diff_sha256=diff_sha256,
639        files_modified=sorted(files),
640    )

Computes a cryptographic fingerprint of the repository state bound to this task. Uses git HEAD commit SHA, status porcelain, and attributable diff content.

def check_repository_drift( approved_fingerprint: RepositoryStateFingerprint, current_fingerprint: RepositoryStateFingerprint) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]: 
643def check_repository_drift(
644    approved_fingerprint: RepositoryStateFingerprint,
645    current_fingerprint: RepositoryStateFingerprint,
646) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[str]]:
647    """
648    Compares the approved repository state fingerprint with current repository state.
649    Returns (has_drift, drift_reason).
650    """
651    if approved_fingerprint.commit_sha != current_fingerprint.commit_sha:
652        return True, f"HEAD commit changed (approved {approved_fingerprint.commit_sha[:8]}, current {current_fingerprint.commit_sha[:8]})"
653
654    if approved_fingerprint.diff_sha256 != current_fingerprint.diff_sha256:
655        return True, "Attributable diff content modified since authorization"
656
657    if approved_fingerprint.files_modified != current_fingerprint.files_modified:
658        return True, f"Modified files changed (approved {approved_fingerprint.files_modified}, current {current_fingerprint.files_modified})"
659
660    return False, None

Compares the approved repository state fingerprint with current repository state. Returns (has_drift, drift_reason).

class HumanLifecycleManager: 
 663class HumanLifecycleManager:
 664    """
 665    Orchestrates human decision capture, state validation, drift verification,
 666    idempotency enforcement, bounded execution handoff, and task resumption.
 667    """
 668
 669    @staticmethod
 670    def get_run_dir(target_repo: Union[str, Path], task_id: str) -> Path:
 671        return Path(target_repo).resolve() / ".task_runs" / task_id
 672
 673    @staticmethod
 674    def load_task_spec(run_dir: Path) -> TaskSpec:
 675        task_file = run_dir / "task.yaml"
 676        if not task_file.is_file():
 677            raise TaskRunNotFoundError(f"Task spec not found at {task_file}")
 678        return TaskSpec.load_from_file(str(task_file))
 679
 680    @staticmethod
 681    def load_decision(run_dir: Path) -> Optional[HumanDecisionRecord]:
 682        dec_file = run_dir / "human_decision.json"
 683        if not dec_file.is_file():
 684            return None
 685        return HumanDecisionRecord.load_from_file(str(dec_file))
 686
 687    @classmethod
 688    def _prepare_decision(
 689        cls,
 690        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 691        task_id: str,
 692        decision: str,
 693        reason: Optional[str] = None,
 694    ) -> Tuple[Path, TaskSpec, RepositoryStateFingerprint, Optional[str], List[str], Optional[str]]:
 695        run_dir = cls.get_run_dir(target_repo, task_id)
 696        if not run_dir.is_dir() or not (run_dir / "task.yaml").is_file():
 697            raise TaskRunNotFoundError(f"Task run '{task_id}' not found in {target_repo}/.task_runs")
 698
 699        task_spec = cls.load_task_spec(run_dir)
 700
 701        existing = cls.load_decision(run_dir)
 702        if existing:
 703            if existing.decision == decision:
 704                if not reason or reason == existing.reason:
 705                    return run_dir, task_spec, None, None, None, None
 706            else:
 707                opp = "APPROVED" if decision == "rejected" else "REJECTED"
 708                raise ContradictoryDecisionError(
 709                    f"Task '{task_id}' was previously {opp}. Contradictory {decision} rejected (fail-closed)."
 710                )
 711
 712        if decision == "approved" and task_spec.current_state != "awaiting_human":
 713            if task_spec.current_state == "complete":
 714                raise InvalidTaskStateError(f"Task '{task_id}' is already COMPLETE.")
 715            if task_spec.current_state == "failed":
 716                raise InvalidTaskStateError(f"Task '{task_id}' is in FAILED state. Cannot approve a failed task.")
 717            raise InvalidTaskStateError(
 718                f"Task '{task_id}' is in state '{task_spec.current_state}'. Only tasks in AWAITING_HUMAN state can be approved."
 719            )
 720
 721        current_fp = compute_repository_fingerprint(target_repo, run_dir)
 722        dp_file = run_dir / "decision_packet.md"
 723        dp_sha = (
 724            hashlib.sha256(dp_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 725            if dp_file.is_file()
 726            else None
 727        )
 728
 729        triggers = list(task_spec.human_approval_requirements or [])
 730        changeops_dec_id = None
 731        if dp_file.is_file():
 732            dp_text = dp_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 733            for line in dp_text.splitlines():
 734                if line.startswith("- ⚠️ **") and "**:" in line:
 735                    t_name = line.split("**")[1].strip()
 736                    if t_name and t_name not in triggers:
 737                        triggers.append(t_name)
 738                elif "ChangeOps Decision ID:" in line:
 739                    dec_val = line.split("`")[1].strip() if "`" in line else ""
 740                    if dec_val and dec_val != "None":
 741                        changeops_dec_id = dec_val
 742
 743        return run_dir, task_spec, current_fp, dp_sha, triggers, changeops_dec_id
 744
 745    @classmethod
 746    def approve(
 747        cls,
 748        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 749        task_id: str,
 750        reason: Optional[str] = None,
 751        operator_source: str = "cli",
 752        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
 753    ) -> HumanDecisionRecord:
 754        """
 755        Records an explicit human approval for a task awaiting authorization.
 756        Enforces idempotency, fail-closed contradictory checks, repository state binding,
 757        and links authorization to HowlChangeOps when applicable.
 758        """
 759        run_dir, task_spec, current_fp, dp_sha, triggers, changeops_dec_id = cls._prepare_decision(
 760            target_repo, task_id, "approved", reason=reason
 761        )
 762        if current_fp is None:
 763            return cls.load_decision(run_dir)
 764
 765        patch_file = run_dir / "diff.patch"
 766        if patch_file.is_file():
 767            reviewed_diff = patch_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
 768            reviewed_sha = hashlib.sha256(reviewed_diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
 769            if current_fp.diff_sha256 != reviewed_sha:
 770                raise RepositoryDriftError(
 771                    f"Repository code has changed since task '{task_id}' was reviewed. Approval cannot authorize unreviewed changes."
 772                )
 773
 774        record = HumanDecisionRecord(
 775            task_id=task_id,
 776            decision="approved",
 777            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 778            boundary_triggers=triggers,
 779            operator_source=operator_source,
 780            reason=reason,
 781            repository=Path(target_repo).name,
 782            repository_state=current_fp,
 783            decision_packet_sha256=dp_sha,
 784            changeops_decision_id=changeops_dec_id,
 785        )
 786        record.save_to_file(run_dir / "human_decision.json")
 787
 788        # Link to HowlChangeOps approval if available
 789        if changeops_dec_id:
 790            try:
 791                from howlplane.control_plane.executor import HowlChangeOpsExecutor
 792                executor = HowlChangeOpsExecutor()
 793                if executor.is_available():
 794                    executor.approve(changeops_dec_id, target_repo, run_dir)
 795            except Exception:
 796                pass
 797
 798        if ledger:
 799            ledger.append_entry(
 800                EvidenceEntry(
 801                    task_id=task_id,
 802                    agent_id="human_operator",
 803                    action="human_approval",
 804                    result="approved",
 805                    human_decision="approved",
 806                    artifact=str(run_dir / "human_decision.json"),
 807                    metadata={
 808                        "reason": reason,
 809                        "operator_source": operator_source,
 810                        "boundaries": triggers,
 811                        "commit_sha": current_fp.commit_sha,
 812                        "changeops_decision_id": changeops_dec_id,
 813                    },
 814                )
 815            )
 816
 817        return record
 818
 819    @classmethod
 820    def reject(
 821        cls,
 822        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 823        task_id: str,
 824        reason: Optional[str] = None,
 825        operator_source: str = "cli",
 826        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
 827    ) -> HumanDecisionRecord:
 828        """
 829        Records an explicit human rejection for a task.
 830        Enforces fail-closed behavior, transitions task to FAILED, and records evidence.
 831        """
 832        run_dir, task_spec, current_fp, dp_sha, triggers, changeops_dec_id = cls._prepare_decision(
 833            target_repo, task_id, "rejected", reason=reason
 834        )
 835        if current_fp is None:
 836            return cls.load_decision(run_dir)
 837
 838        record = HumanDecisionRecord(
 839            task_id=task_id,
 840            decision="rejected",
 841            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 842            boundary_triggers=triggers,
 843            operator_source=operator_source,
 844            reason=reason,
 845            repository=Path(target_repo).name,
 846            repository_state=current_fp,
 847            decision_packet_sha256=dp_sha,
 848            changeops_decision_id=changeops_dec_id,
 849        )
 850        record.save_to_file(run_dir / "human_decision.json")
 851
 852        rej_reason = f"Human operator rejected authorization: {reason or 'No reason provided'}"
 853        try:
 854            from howlplane.control_plane.checkpoints import CheckpointManager
 855            active_stage = task_spec.current_state if task_spec.current_state not in ("failed", "cancelled") else None
 856            CheckpointManager.fail_stage(
 857                run_dir,
 858                stage=active_stage,
 859                reason=rej_reason,
 860                result_summary={"error": rej_reason, "decision": "rejected"},
 861            )
 862        except Exception:
 863            pass
 864
 865        task_spec.transition_to(
 866            "failed",
 867            rej_reason,
 868        )
 869        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 870
 871        if ledger:
 872            ledger.append_entry(
 873                EvidenceEntry(
 874                    task_id=task_id,
 875                    agent_id="human_operator",
 876                    action="human_rejection",
 877                    result="rejected",
 878                    human_decision="rejected",
 879                    artifact=str(run_dir / "human_decision.json"),
 880                    metadata={"reason": reason, "operator_source": operator_source},
 881                )
 882            )
 883
 884        return record
 885
 886    @classmethod
 887    def _ensure_deterministic_verification(
 888        cls,
 889        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 890        run_dir: Path,
 891        task_spec: Any,
 892        orchestrator: Optional[Any],
 893        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger],
 894        lock_ownership: Optional[Any] = None,
 895    ) -> str:
 896        """Returns the task's real deterministic verification status.
 897
 898        The question "did this task escalate before Stage 6" is answered by the
 899        verification evidence itself rather than inferred from a checkpoint
 900        stage: a plan whose `overall_status` is still `unverified` has not run,
 901        whatever else the run recorded. That is also the fail-closed reading for
 902        tasks serialized before this fix -- they report `unverified`, so the
 903        gate executes rather than being assumed to have passed.
 904
 905        A plan that already reports a terminal status keeps it. Post-verification
 906        approvals therefore retain exactly their previous semantics, and a repeat
 907        resume cannot re-run a recorded failure into a pass (issues.md #12).
 908
 909        Returns VERIFICATION_NO_PLAN for a task run that has no plan at all,
 910        which no governed run produces.
 911        """
 912        from howlplane.control_plane.atomic_io import safe_load_json
 913        from howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator import (
 914            GovernedTaskOrchestrator,
 915            OrchestrationConfig,
 916            TERMINAL_VERIFICATION_STATUSES,
 917        )
 918
 919        plan_file = run_dir / "verification_plan.json"
 920        if not plan_file.is_file():
 921            return VERIFICATION_NO_PLAN
 922        try:
 923            recorded = safe_load_json(plan_file).get("overall_status")
 924        except Exception:
 925            recorded = None
 926        if recorded in TERMINAL_VERIFICATION_STATUSES:
 927            return recorded
 928
 929        runner = orchestrator
 930        if runner is None or not hasattr(runner, "run_deterministic_verification"):
 931            runner = GovernedTaskOrchestrator(
 932                target_repo=target_repo,
 933                config=OrchestrationConfig(
 934                    acquire_locks=False,
 935                    record_evidence=bool(ledger),
 936                ),
 937            )
 938        status = runner.run_deterministic_verification(task_spec, run_dir=run_dir)
 939
 940        if ledger:
 941            ledger.append_entry(
 942                EvidenceEntry(
 943                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 944                    agent_id="control_plane",
 945                    action="verification_executed_on_resume",
 946                    result=status,
 947                    metadata={
 948                        "trigger": "pre_verification_escalation_approved",
 949                        "authorizes": "workflow_continuation_not_correctness",
 950                    },
 951                )
 952            )
 953        return status
 954
 955    @classmethod
 956    def _unverified_terminal_result(
 957        cls,
 958        task_id: str,
 959        task_spec: Any,
 960        run_dir: Path,
 961        verif_status: str,
 962        decision: Any,
 963        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger],
 964    ) -> Any:
 965        """Ends a resumed task truthfully when verification did not pass.
 966
 967        There is deliberately no override here. A human authorizing the workflow
 968        to continue is a different act from a human overruling a failed
 969        deterministic gate; the second would need its own explicit authority
 970        operation with its own evidence and its own terminal semantics, and does
 971        not exist (issues.md #12).
 972        """
 973        from howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator import OrchestrationResult
 974
 975        # `failed` is what the ordinary Stage 6 gate uses for a plan that ran
 976        # and failed, so a resumed run reaches the same terminal state by the
 977        # same evidence. Anything short of a completed run -- a plan that
 978        # errored, was never run, or came back partial -- is `blocked`: the
 979        # implementation was not judged, so it must not be recorded as judged.
 980        terminal = "failed" if verif_status == "failed" else "blocked"
 981        reason = (
 982            f"Human approval authorized the governed workflow to continue, not "
 983            f"the implementation's correctness. Deterministic verification "
 984            f"reported '{verif_status}', so this task cannot be recorded as "
 985            f"verified-complete."
 986        )
 987        task_spec.transition_to(terminal, reason)
 988        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 989
 990        summary_file = run_dir / "summary.md"
 991        if not summary_file.is_file():
 992            summary_file.write_text(
 993                f"# Governed Task Run Summary: `{task_id}`\n\n"
 994                f"- **Objective:** {task_spec.objective}\n"
 995                f"- **Final State:** `{terminal.upper()}`\n"
 996                f"- **Deterministic Verification:** `{verif_status}`\n"
 997                f"- **Approved At:** {decision.timestamp}\n\n"
 998                f"{reason}\n",
 999                encoding="utf-8",
1000            )
1001
1002        if ledger:
1003            ledger.append_entry(
1004                EvidenceEntry(
1005                    task_id=task_id,
1006                    agent_id="control_plane",
1007                    action="resume_blocked_on_verification",
1008                    result=verif_status,
1009                    task_class=task_spec.task_class,
1010                    risk_level=task_spec.risk_level,
1011                    metadata={
1012                        "human_approved": True,
1013                        "verification_status": verif_status,
1014                        "final_state": terminal,
1015                    },
1016                )
1017            )
1018
1019        return OrchestrationResult(
1020            task_id=task_id,
1021            task_spec=task_spec,
1022            final_state=terminal,
1023            exit_code=1,
1024            run_dir=str(run_dir),
1025        )
1026
1027    @classmethod
1028    def resume(
1029        cls,
1030        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
1031        task_id: str,
1032        orchestrator: Optional[Any] = None,
1033        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
1034        control_plane_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
1035    ) -> Any:
1036        """
1037        Resumes task execution from durable task-run artifacts.
1038        Validates approval status, repository drift, executes bounded consequential actions,
1039        verifies execution receipts, and transitions to COMPLETE only upon verified proof.
1040        """
1041        from howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator import OrchestrationResult
1042        from howlplane.control_plane.executor import (
1043            ExecutionReceipt,
1044            ExecutorRegistry,
1045            ExecutionFailedError,
1046            InvalidReceiptError,
1047            UnsupportedActionError,
1048        )
1049        from howlplane.control_plane.locking import TaskLock
1050        from howlplane.control_plane.proposed_action import infer_proposed_actions, ProposedAction
1051
1052        run_dir = cls.get_run_dir(target_repo, task_id)
1053        if not run_dir.is_dir() or not (run_dir / "task.yaml").is_file():
1054            raise TaskRunNotFoundError(f"Task run '{task_id}' not found in {target_repo}/.task_runs")
1055
1056        # Recovery is governed execution, so it leaves evidence like any other
1057        # stage. SLOPFIX-06's two failed resumes mutated progress and lock state
1058        # and recorded nothing, leaving no durable account of why the documented
1059        # recovery path did not work.
1060        def audit(action, result=None, **metadata):
1061            if not ledger:
1062                return
1063            try:
1064                ledger.append_entry(
1065                    EvidenceEntry(
1066                        task_id=task_id,
1067                        agent_id="control_plane",
1068                        action=action,
1069                        command=f"ai resume {task_id}",
1070                        result=result,
1071                        repository=str(target_repo),
1072                        metadata=metadata,
1073                    )
1074                )
1075            except Exception:
1076                pass
1077
1078        lock_state = cls._describe_lock_state(target_repo, task_id)
1079        audit("resume_requested", "REQUESTED", lock_state=lock_state)
1080        audit("resume_lock_state", lock_state.get("blocking_state"), **lock_state)
1081
1082        task_lock = TaskLock(
1083            target_repo, task_id, operation="resume", command=f"ai resume {task_id}"
1084        )
1085        try:
1086            task_lock.acquire()
1087        except Exception as err:
1088            audit(
1089                "resume_failed",
1090                "LOCK_UNAVAILABLE",
1091                error=str(err),
1092                lock_state=lock_state,
1093            )
1094            raise
1095
1096        try:
1097            task_spec = cls.load_task_spec(run_dir)
1098            audit(
1099                "resume_started",
1100                "STARTED",
1101                previous_state=task_spec.current_state,
1102                lock_state=lock_state,
1103            )
1104
1105            if task_spec.current_state == "complete":
1106                return OrchestrationResult(
1107                    task_id=task_id,
1108                    task_spec=task_spec,
1109                    final_state="complete",
1110                    exit_code=0,
1111                    run_dir=str(run_dir),
1112                )
1113
1114            if task_spec.current_state == "cancelled":
1115                raise InvalidTaskStateError(f"Task '{task_id}' was CANCELLED and cannot be resumed.")
1116
1117            if task_spec.current_state == "failed":
1118                dec = cls.load_decision(run_dir)
1119                if dec and dec.decision == "rejected":
1120                    raise InvalidTaskStateError(
1121                        f"Task '{task_id}' was rejected by human operator and cannot be resumed."
1122                    )
1123                raise InvalidTaskStateError(
1124                    f"Task '{task_id}' is in FAILED state. Cannot resume a failed task without re-running."
1125                )
1126
1127            if task_spec.current_state == "awaiting_human":
1128                decision = cls.load_decision(run_dir)
1129                if not decision:
1130                    raise ApprovalRequiredError(
1131                        f"Task '{task_id}' is AWAITING_HUMAN and requires explicit human approval before resuming. Run 'howlplane approve {task_id}'."
1132                    )
1133                if decision.decision == "rejected":
1134                    raise InvalidTaskStateError(f"Task '{task_id}' authorization was REJECTED by human operator.")
1135
1136                if decision.decision == "approved":
1137                    # Validate repository state binding (drift check)
1138                    current_fp = compute_repository_fingerprint(target_repo, run_dir)
1139                    if decision.repository_state:
1140                        has_drift, drift_reason = check_repository_drift(decision.repository_state, current_fp)
1141                        if has_drift:
1142                            if ledger:
1143                                ledger.append_entry(
1144                                    EvidenceEntry(
1145                                        task_id=task_id,
1146                                        agent_id="control_plane",
1147                                        action="stale_approval_detected",
1148                                        result=f"Repository drift detected: {drift_reason}",
1149                                        metadata={"drift_reason": drift_reason},
1150                                    )
1151                                )
1152                            raise StaleApprovalError(
1153                                f"Repository state has drifted since approval was granted ({drift_reason}). "
1154                                f"Approval is STALE. Re-review and re-approval required."
1155                            )
1156
1157                    # Check if this task requires bounded consequential execution
1158                    exec_boundaries = [b for b in decision.boundary_triggers if b in EXECUTABLE_BOUNDARIES]
1159                    if not exec_boundaries and task_spec.human_approval_requirements:
1160                        exec_boundaries = [b for b in task_spec.human_approval_requirements if b in EXECUTABLE_BOUNDARIES]
1161
1162                    receipt_file = run_dir / "execution_receipt.json"
1163
1164                    if exec_boundaries:
1165                        # Bounded consequential execution is required! Approval alone != Complete
1166                        if receipt_file.is_file():
1167                            try:
1168                                receipt = ExecutionReceipt.load_from_file(receipt_file)
1169                            except Exception as e:
1170                                raise InvalidReceiptError(f"Execution receipt at {receipt_file} is malformed: {e}")
1171
1172                            executor = (
1173                                ExecutorRegistry.get_executor(receipt.executor)
1174                                or ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(receipt.action_type)
1175                            )
1176                            if not executor:
1177                                raise InvalidReceiptError(f"Unknown executor '{receipt.executor}' in execution receipt")
1178
1179                            is_valid, val_reason = executor.verify_receipt(
1180                                receipt,
1181                                expected_action=receipt.action_type,
1182                                expected_repo=Path(target_repo).name,
1183                                expected_commit=current_fp.commit_sha,
1184                                run_dir=run_dir,
1185                            )
1186                            if not is_valid:
1187                                raise InvalidReceiptError(f"Execution receipt verification failed: {val_reason}")
1188                        else:
1189                            # Infer the consequential actions to execute
1190                            proposed_actions = infer_proposed_actions(
1191                                objective=task_spec.objective,
1192                                repo_name=Path(target_repo).name,
1193                                human_approval_requirements=decision.boundary_triggers,
1194                            )
1195                            if not proposed_actions:
1196                                primary_b = exec_boundaries[0]
1197                                proposed_actions = [
1198                                    ProposedAction(
1199                                        action_type=primary_b,
1200                                        target_repo=Path(target_repo).name,
1201                                        authority_boundary=primary_b,
1202                                        risk_level="critical" if primary_b in ("infrastructure_apply", "destructive_database_change") else "high",
1203                                    )
1204                                ]
1205
1206                            for action in proposed_actions:
1207                                executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(action.action_type)
1208                                if action.executor_id and not executor:
1209                                    executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor(action.executor_id)
1210
1211                                if not executor or not executor.is_available() or not executor.supports_action(action.action_type):
1212                                    raise UnsupportedActionError(
1213                                        f"AUTHORIZED ACTION CANNOT EXECUTE: No configured bounded executor supports '{action.action_type}'. "
1214                                        f"Task cannot complete without trusted bounded execution."
1215                                    )
1216
1217                                # Resolve or evaluate decision_id
1218                                decision_id = action.decision_id or decision.changeops_decision_id
1219                                if not decision_id:
1220                                    verdict, dec_id, eval_reason = executor.evaluate(action, target_repo, run_dir)
1221                                    if verdict == "DENY":
1222                                        raise ExecutionFailedError(f"Bounded executor policy denied execution: {eval_reason}")
1223                                    decision_id = dec_id
1224
1225                                if not decision_id:
1226                                    raise ExecutionFailedError(
1227                                        f"Failed to obtain decision ID from bounded executor for '{action.action_type}'"
1228                                    )
1229
1230                                # Check if already executed natively before calling execute (Prevent Replay Hazard!)
1231                                q_status, q_receipt, q_msg = executor.query_execution_status(
1232                                    decision_id=decision_id,
1233                                    repo_path=target_repo,
1234                                    task_run_dir=run_dir,
1235                                    action=action,
1236                                    task_id=task_id,
1237                                )
1238
1239                                if q_status == "already_executed" and q_receipt:
1240                                    # Native receipt successfully recovered! Verify and advance
1241                                    is_valid, val_reason = executor.verify_receipt(
1242                                        q_receipt,
1243                                        expected_action=action.action_type,
1244                                        expected_repo=Path(target_repo).name,
1245                                        expected_commit=current_fp.commit_sha,
1246                                        run_dir=run_dir,
1247                                    )
1248                                    if not is_valid:
1249                                        raise InvalidReceiptError(f"Recovered native execution receipt verification failed: {val_reason}")
1250                                    continue
1251                                elif q_status == "ambiguous":
1252                                    raise ExecutionFailedError(
1253                                        f"Ambiguous execution state for decision '{decision_id}': {q_msg}. Human intervention required."
1254                                    )
1255                                elif q_status == "failed":
1256                                    raise ExecutionFailedError(
1257                                        f"Prior native execution for decision '{decision_id}' failed: {q_msg}."
1258                                    )
1259
1260                                # Submit approval linkage
1261                                app_ok, app_msg = executor.approve(decision_id, target_repo, run_dir)
1262                                if not app_ok and "already approved" not in (app_msg or "").lower():
1263                                    if "key" in (app_msg or "").lower() or "not set" in (app_msg or "").lower():
1264                                        raise ExecutionFailedError(f"Bounded execution authorization failed: {app_msg}")
1265
1266                                # Execute bounded action
1267                                exec_res = executor.execute(decision_id, target_repo, run_dir, action, task_id)
1268                                if exec_res.status == "stale":
1269                                    if ledger:
1270                                        ledger.append_entry(
1271                                            EvidenceEntry(
1272                                                task_id=task_id,
1273                                                agent_id=executor.name,
1274                                                action="stale_evidence_detected",
1275                                                result=exec_res.error_message,
1276                                                metadata={"decision_id": decision_id},
1277                                            )
1278                                        )
1279                                    raise StaleApprovalError(f"Bounded executor detected stale evidence / TOCTOU drift: {exec_res.error_message}")
1280
1281                                if exec_res.status != "success" or not exec_res.receipt:
1282                                    raise ExecutionFailedError(f"Bounded execution failed: {exec_res.error_message}")
1283
1284                                # Verify receipt
1285                                is_valid, val_reason = executor.verify_receipt(
1286                                    exec_res.receipt,
1287                                    expected_action=action.action_type,
1288                                    expected_repo=Path(target_repo).name,
1289                                    expected_commit=current_fp.commit_sha,
1290                                    run_dir=run_dir,
1291                                )
1292                                if not is_valid:
1293                                    raise InvalidReceiptError(f"Execution receipt verification failed: {val_reason}")
1294
1295                                if ledger:
1296                                    ledger.append_entry(
1297                                        EvidenceEntry(
1298                                            task_id=task_id,
1299                                            agent_id=executor.name,
1300                                            action="bounded_execution_completed",
1301                                            result="success",
1302                                            artifact=exec_res.receipt_path,
1303                                            metadata={
1304                                                "executor": executor.name,
1305                                                "decision_id": decision_id,
1306                                                "action_type": action.action_type,
1307                                                "verification_status": exec_res.verification_status,
1308                                            },
1309                                        )
1310                                    )
1311
1312                    # Ordinary approval authorizes the governed workflow to
1313                    # continue. It is not a human declaration that the
1314                    # implementation is correct, and it cannot stand in for the
1315                    # deterministic gate. A task that escalated before Stage 6
1316                    # has never had its verification plan executed, so
1317                    # completing here would claim a verification that never
1318                    # happened -- HOWLFRAM-BUG-50 reported
1319                    # `Final state: COMPLETE (Exit 0)` while
1320                    # verification_plan.json still read `overall_status:
1321                    # unverified` with every step `claimed` (issues.md #12).
1322                    verif_status = cls._ensure_deterministic_verification(
1323                        target_repo=target_repo,
1324                        run_dir=run_dir,
1325                        task_spec=task_spec,
1326                        orchestrator=orchestrator,
1327                        ledger=ledger,
1328                        lock_ownership=task_lock.ownership,
1329                    )
1330                    if verif_status not in (
1331                        VERIFICATION_PASSED,
1332                        VERIFICATION_NO_PLAN,
1333                    ):
1334                        return cls._unverified_terminal_result(
1335                            task_id=task_id,
1336                            task_spec=task_spec,
1337                            run_dir=run_dir,
1338                            verif_status=verif_status,
1339                            decision=decision,
1340                            ledger=ledger,
1341                        )
1342
1343                    # Valid approval (+ valid bounded execution receipt if required) -> complete
1344                    if ledger:
1345                        ledger.append_entry(
1346                            EvidenceEntry(
1347                                task_id=task_id,
1348                                agent_id="control_plane",
1349                                action="task_resumed",
1350                                metadata={"task_id": task_id, "resumed_from": "awaiting_human"},
1351                            )
1352                        )
1353
1354                    task_spec.transition_to(
1355                        "complete",
1356                        f"Human authority approved ({decision.reason or 'No reason specified'}): all gates and bounded execution satisfied.",
1357                    )
1358                    task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1359
1360                    if ledger:
1361                        ledger.append_entry(
1362                            EvidenceEntry(
1363                                task_id=task_id,
1364                                agent_id="control_plane",
1365                                action="task_completed",
1366                                task_class=task_spec.task_class,
1367                                risk_level=task_spec.risk_level,
1368                                reasoning_tier=task_spec.recommended_reasoning_tier,
1369                                metadata={"human_approved": True, "resumed": True},
1370                            )
1371                        )
1372
1373                    summary_file = run_dir / "summary.md"
1374                    if not summary_file.is_file():
1375                        # "Verified" is read off the executed plan, never
1376                        # asserted because a human approved continuation.
1377                        summary_file.write_text(
1378                            f"# Governed Task Run Summary: `{task_id}`\n\n"
1379                            f"- **Objective:** {task_spec.objective}\n"
1380                            f"- **Final State:** `COMPLETE` "
1381                            f"(Human Approved; Deterministic Verification "
1382                            f"`{verif_status}`)\n"
1383                            f"- **Approved At:** {decision.timestamp}\n",
1384                            encoding="utf-8",
1385                        )
1386
1387                    return OrchestrationResult(
1388                        task_id=task_id,
1389                        task_spec=task_spec,
1390                        final_state="complete",
1391                        exit_code=0,
1392                        run_dir=str(run_dir),
1393                    )
1394
1395            # For tasks interrupted in intermediate states (discovered, planned,
1396            # implementing, reviewing, verifying, interrupted). The orchestrator
1397            # needs the same task lock this method already holds, so it is handed
1398            # the ownership token rather than being made to acquire it again --
1399            # which is what deadlocked every documented recovery
1400            # (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
1401            if orchestrator:
1402                outcome = orchestrator.run(
1403                    task_spec, lock_ownership=task_lock.ownership
1404                )
1405            else:
1406                from howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator import GovernedTaskOrchestrator
1407                orch = GovernedTaskOrchestrator(
1408                    target_repo=target_repo,
1409                    control_plane_root=control_plane_root,
1410                )
1411                outcome = orch.run(task_spec, lock_ownership=task_lock.ownership)
1412            audit(
1413                "resume_completed",
1414                getattr(outcome, "final_state", None),
1415                exit_code=getattr(outcome, "exit_code", None),
1416                checkpoint=cls._latest_checkpoint_stage(run_dir),
1417            )
1418            return outcome
1419        except Exception as err:
1420            audit(
1421                "resume_failed",
1422                type(err).__name__,
1423                error=str(err),
1424                checkpoint=cls._latest_checkpoint_stage(run_dir),
1425            )
1426            raise
1427        finally:
1428            task_lock.release()
1429
1430    @staticmethod
1431    def _latest_checkpoint_stage(run_dir: Path) -> Optional[str]:
1432        """Names the stage a recovery attempt actually left behind, if any."""
1433        try:
1434            from howlplane.control_plane.checkpoints import CheckpointManager
1435
1436            checkpoint = CheckpointManager.load_latest_checkpoint(run_dir)
1437            if checkpoint is None:
1438                return None
1439            return f"{checkpoint.stage}:{checkpoint.status}"
1440        except Exception:
1441            return None
1442
1443    @staticmethod
1444    def _describe_lock_state(target_repo, task_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
1445        """Classifies every lock relevant to a task before recovery touches it.
1446
1447        Recorded up front so a failed resume explains itself: which lock stood
1448        in the way, whose it was, and whether it was reclaimable.
1449        """
1450        from howlplane.control_plane.atomic_io import safe_load_json
1451        from howlplane.control_plane.locking import (
1452            classify_lock_owner,
1453            get_repo_lock_path,
1454            get_task_lock_path,
1455        )
1456
1457        locks: Dict[str, Any] = {}
1458        blocking = "NONE"
1459        for scope, path in (
1460            ("task_run", get_task_lock_path(target_repo, task_id)),
1461            ("repository", get_repo_lock_path(target_repo)),
1462        ):
1463            if not path.exists():
1464                locks[scope] = {"held": False}
1465                continue
1466            try:
1467                owner = safe_load_json(path)
1468            except Exception as err:
1469                locks[scope] = {"held": True, "unreadable": str(err)}
1470                blocking = "UNREADABLE"
1471                continue
1472            state, reason = classify_lock_owner(
1473                owner.get("pid", -1),
1474                owner.get("hostname", ""),
1475                owner.get("process_create_time", 0.0),
1476            )
1477            locks[scope] = {
1478                "held": True,
1479                "path": str(path),
1480                "owner_state": state.value,
1481                "reason": reason,
1482                "pid": owner.get("pid"),
1483                "hostname": owner.get("hostname"),
1484                "task_id": owner.get("task_id"),
1485                "operation": owner.get("operation"),
1486            }
1487            if state.value != "STALE" or blocking == "NONE":
1488                blocking = state.value
1489        return {"locks": locks, "blocking_state": blocking}
1490
1491    @classmethod
1492    def cancel(
1493        cls,
1494        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
1495        task_id: str,
1496        reason: Optional[str] = None,
1497        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
1498    ) -> Any:
1499        """
1500        Cancels an active or interrupted task run safely.
1501        Terminates child processes, releases locks, and transitions state to 'cancelled'.
1502        Never reverts or destroys repository working tree changes.
1503        """
1504        from howlplane.control_plane.checkpoints import CheckpointManager
1505        from howlplane.control_plane.locking import TaskLock
1506        from howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator import OrchestrationResult
1507        from howlplane.control_plane.process_manager import ProcessTracker
1508
1509        run_dir = cls.get_run_dir(target_repo, task_id)
1510        if not run_dir.is_dir() or not (run_dir / "task.yaml").is_file():
1511            raise TaskRunNotFoundError(f"Task run '{task_id}' not found in {target_repo}/.task_runs")
1512
1513        with TaskLock(target_repo, task_id, operation="cancel", command=f"ai cancel {task_id}"):
1514            task_spec = cls.load_task_spec(run_dir)
1515
1516            if task_spec.current_state == "complete":
1517                raise InvalidTaskStateError(f"Task '{task_id}' is already COMPLETE and cannot be cancelled.")
1518
1519            if task_spec.current_state == "cancelled":
1520                return OrchestrationResult(
1521                    task_id=task_id,
1522                    task_spec=task_spec,
1523                    final_state="cancelled",
1524                    exit_code=0,
1525                    run_dir=str(run_dir),
1526                )
1527
1528            # Terminate active process if running
1529            terminated, term_msg = ProcessTracker.terminate_task_process(run_dir)
1530
1531            cancel_reason = reason or "Cancelled by human operator via CLI"
1532            task_spec.transition_to("cancelled", cancel_reason)
1533            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1534
1535            CheckpointManager.record_interrupted(
1536                run_dir,
1537                stage="cancelled",
1538                reason=cancel_reason,
1539                metadata={"process_terminated": terminated, "process_message": term_msg},
1540            )
1541
1542            if ledger:
1543                ledger.append_entry(
1544                    EvidenceEntry(
1545                        task_id=task_id,
1546                        agent_id="control_plane",
1547                        action="task_cancelled",
1548                        result="cancelled",
1549                        metadata={"reason": cancel_reason, "process_terminated": terminated},
1550                    )
1551                )
1552
1553            return OrchestrationResult(
1554                task_id=task_id,
1555                task_spec=task_spec,
1556                final_state="cancelled",
1557                exit_code=0,
1558                run_dir=str(run_dir),
1559            )

Orchestrates human decision capture, state validation, drift verification, idempotency enforcement, bounded execution handoff, and task resumption.

@staticmethod
def get_run_dir(target_repo: Union[str, pathlib.Path], task_id: str) -> pathlib.Path: 
669    @staticmethod
670    def get_run_dir(target_repo: Union[str, Path], task_id: str) -> Path:
671        return Path(target_repo).resolve() / ".task_runs" / task_id
@staticmethod
def load_task_spec(run_dir: pathlib.Path) -> howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec: 
673    @staticmethod
674    def load_task_spec(run_dir: Path) -> TaskSpec:
675        task_file = run_dir / "task.yaml"
676        if not task_file.is_file():
677            raise TaskRunNotFoundError(f"Task spec not found at {task_file}")
678        return TaskSpec.load_from_file(str(task_file))
@staticmethod
def load_decision( run_dir: pathlib.Path) -> Optional[HumanDecisionRecord]: 
680    @staticmethod
681    def load_decision(run_dir: Path) -> Optional[HumanDecisionRecord]:
682        dec_file = run_dir / "human_decision.json"
683        if not dec_file.is_file():
684            return None
685        return HumanDecisionRecord.load_from_file(str(dec_file))
@classmethod
def approve( cls, target_repo: Union[str, pathlib.Path], task_id: str, reason: Optional[str] = None, operator_source: str = 'cli', ledger: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.evidence_ledger.EvidenceLedger] = None) -> HumanDecisionRecord: 
745    @classmethod
746    def approve(
747        cls,
748        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
749        task_id: str,
750        reason: Optional[str] = None,
751        operator_source: str = "cli",
752        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
753    ) -> HumanDecisionRecord:
754        """
755        Records an explicit human approval for a task awaiting authorization.
756        Enforces idempotency, fail-closed contradictory checks, repository state binding,
757        and links authorization to HowlChangeOps when applicable.
758        """
759        run_dir, task_spec, current_fp, dp_sha, triggers, changeops_dec_id = cls._prepare_decision(
760            target_repo, task_id, "approved", reason=reason
761        )
762        if current_fp is None:
763            return cls.load_decision(run_dir)
764
765        patch_file = run_dir / "diff.patch"
766        if patch_file.is_file():
767            reviewed_diff = patch_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
768            reviewed_sha = hashlib.sha256(reviewed_diff.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
769            if current_fp.diff_sha256 != reviewed_sha:
770                raise RepositoryDriftError(
771                    f"Repository code has changed since task '{task_id}' was reviewed. Approval cannot authorize unreviewed changes."
772                )
773
774        record = HumanDecisionRecord(
775            task_id=task_id,
776            decision="approved",
777            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
778            boundary_triggers=triggers,
779            operator_source=operator_source,
780            reason=reason,
781            repository=Path(target_repo).name,
782            repository_state=current_fp,
783            decision_packet_sha256=dp_sha,
784            changeops_decision_id=changeops_dec_id,
785        )
786        record.save_to_file(run_dir / "human_decision.json")
787
788        # Link to HowlChangeOps approval if available
789        if changeops_dec_id:
790            try:
791                from howlplane.control_plane.executor import HowlChangeOpsExecutor
792                executor = HowlChangeOpsExecutor()
793                if executor.is_available():
794                    executor.approve(changeops_dec_id, target_repo, run_dir)
795            except Exception:
796                pass
797
798        if ledger:
799            ledger.append_entry(
800                EvidenceEntry(
801                    task_id=task_id,
802                    agent_id="human_operator",
803                    action="human_approval",
804                    result="approved",
805                    human_decision="approved",
806                    artifact=str(run_dir / "human_decision.json"),
807                    metadata={
808                        "reason": reason,
809                        "operator_source": operator_source,
810                        "boundaries": triggers,
811                        "commit_sha": current_fp.commit_sha,
812                        "changeops_decision_id": changeops_dec_id,
813                    },
814                )
815            )
816
817        return record

Records an explicit human approval for a task awaiting authorization. Enforces idempotency, fail-closed contradictory checks, repository state binding, and links authorization to HowlChangeOps when applicable.

@classmethod
def reject( cls, target_repo: Union[str, pathlib.Path], task_id: str, reason: Optional[str] = None, operator_source: str = 'cli', ledger: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.evidence_ledger.EvidenceLedger] = None) -> HumanDecisionRecord: 
819    @classmethod
820    def reject(
821        cls,
822        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
823        task_id: str,
824        reason: Optional[str] = None,
825        operator_source: str = "cli",
826        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
827    ) -> HumanDecisionRecord:
828        """
829        Records an explicit human rejection for a task.
830        Enforces fail-closed behavior, transitions task to FAILED, and records evidence.
831        """
832        run_dir, task_spec, current_fp, dp_sha, triggers, changeops_dec_id = cls._prepare_decision(
833            target_repo, task_id, "rejected", reason=reason
834        )
835        if current_fp is None:
836            return cls.load_decision(run_dir)
837
838        record = HumanDecisionRecord(
839            task_id=task_id,
840            decision="rejected",
841            timestamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
842            boundary_triggers=triggers,
843            operator_source=operator_source,
844            reason=reason,
845            repository=Path(target_repo).name,
846            repository_state=current_fp,
847            decision_packet_sha256=dp_sha,
848            changeops_decision_id=changeops_dec_id,
849        )
850        record.save_to_file(run_dir / "human_decision.json")
851
852        rej_reason = f"Human operator rejected authorization: {reason or 'No reason provided'}"
853        try:
854            from howlplane.control_plane.checkpoints import CheckpointManager
855            active_stage = task_spec.current_state if task_spec.current_state not in ("failed", "cancelled") else None
856            CheckpointManager.fail_stage(
857                run_dir,
858                stage=active_stage,
859                reason=rej_reason,
860                result_summary={"error": rej_reason, "decision": "rejected"},
861            )
862        except Exception:
863            pass
864
865        task_spec.transition_to(
866            "failed",
867            rej_reason,
868        )
869        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
870
871        if ledger:
872            ledger.append_entry(
873                EvidenceEntry(
874                    task_id=task_id,
875                    agent_id="human_operator",
876                    action="human_rejection",
877                    result="rejected",
878                    human_decision="rejected",
879                    artifact=str(run_dir / "human_decision.json"),
880                    metadata={"reason": reason, "operator_source": operator_source},
881                )
882            )
883
884        return record

Records an explicit human rejection for a task. Enforces fail-closed behavior, transitions task to FAILED, and records evidence.

@classmethod
def resume( cls, target_repo: Union[str, pathlib.Path], task_id: str, orchestrator: Optional[Any] = None, ledger: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.evidence_ledger.EvidenceLedger] = None, control_plane_root: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None) -> Any: 
1027    @classmethod
1028    def resume(
1029        cls,
1030        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
1031        task_id: str,
1032        orchestrator: Optional[Any] = None,
1033        ledger: Optional[EvidenceLedger] = None,
1034        control_plane_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
1035    ) -> Any:
1036        """
1037        Resumes task execution from durable task-run artifacts.
1038        Validates approval status, repository drift, executes bounded consequential actions,
1039        verifies execution receipts, and transitions to COMPLETE only upon verified proof.
1040        """
1041        from howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator import OrchestrationResult
1042        from howlplane.control_plane.executor import (
1043            ExecutionReceipt,
1044            ExecutorRegistry,
1045            ExecutionFailedError,
1046            InvalidReceiptError,
1047            UnsupportedActionError,
1048        )
1049        from howlplane.control_plane.locking import TaskLock
1050        from howlplane.control_plane.proposed_action import infer_proposed_actions, ProposedAction
1051
1052        run_dir = cls.get_run_dir(target_repo, task_id)
1053        if not run_dir.is_dir() or not (run_dir / "task.yaml").is_file():
1054            raise TaskRunNotFoundError(f"Task run '{task_id}' not found in {target_repo}/.task_runs")
1055
1056        # Recovery is governed execution, so it leaves evidence like any other
1057        # stage. SLOPFIX-06's two failed resumes mutated progress and lock state
1058        # and recorded nothing, leaving no durable account of why the documented
1059        # recovery path did not work.
1060        def audit(action, result=None, **metadata):
1061            if not ledger:
1062                return
1063            try:
1064                ledger.append_entry(
1065                    EvidenceEntry(
1066                        task_id=task_id,
1067                        agent_id="control_plane",
1068                        action=action,
1069                        command=f"ai resume {task_id}",
1070                        result=result,
1071                        repository=str(target_repo),
1072                        metadata=metadata,
1073                    )
1074                )
1075            except Exception:
1076                pass
1077
1078        lock_state = cls._describe_lock_state(target_repo, task_id)
1079        audit("resume_requested", "REQUESTED", lock_state=lock_state)
1080        audit("resume_lock_state", lock_state.get("blocking_state"), **lock_state)
1081
1082        task_lock = TaskLock(
1083            target_repo, task_id, operation="resume", command=f"ai resume {task_id}"
1084        )
1085        try:
1086            task_lock.acquire()
1087        except Exception as err:
1088            audit(
1089                "resume_failed",
1090                "LOCK_UNAVAILABLE",
1091                error=str(err),
1092                lock_state=lock_state,
1093            )
1094            raise
1095
1096        try:
1097            task_spec = cls.load_task_spec(run_dir)
1098            audit(
1099                "resume_started",
1100                "STARTED",
1101                previous_state=task_spec.current_state,
1102                lock_state=lock_state,
1103            )
1104
1105            if task_spec.current_state == "complete":
1106                return OrchestrationResult(
1107                    task_id=task_id,
1108                    task_spec=task_spec,
1109                    final_state="complete",
1110                    exit_code=0,
1111                    run_dir=str(run_dir),
1112                )
1113
1114            if task_spec.current_state == "cancelled":
1115                raise InvalidTaskStateError(f"Task '{task_id}' was CANCELLED and cannot be resumed.")
1116
1117            if task_spec.current_state == "failed":
1118                dec = cls.load_decision(run_dir)
1119                if dec and dec.decision == "rejected":
1120                    raise InvalidTaskStateError(
1121                        f"Task '{task_id}' was rejected by human operator and cannot be resumed."
1122                    )
1123                raise InvalidTaskStateError(
1124                    f"Task '{task_id}' is in FAILED state. Cannot resume a failed task without re-running."
1125                )
1126
1127            if task_spec.current_state == "awaiting_human":
1128                decision = cls.load_decision(run_dir)
1129                if not decision:
1130                    raise ApprovalRequiredError(
1131                        f"Task '{task_id}' is AWAITING_HUMAN and requires explicit human approval before resuming. Run 'howlplane approve {task_id}'."
1132                    )
1133                if decision.decision == "rejected":
1134                    raise InvalidTaskStateError(f"Task '{task_id}' authorization was REJECTED by human operator.")
1135
1136                if decision.decision == "approved":
1137                    # Validate repository state binding (drift check)
1138                    current_fp = compute_repository_fingerprint(target_repo, run_dir)
1139                    if decision.repository_state:
1140                        has_drift, drift_reason = check_repository_drift(decision.repository_state, current_fp)
1141                        if has_drift:
1142                            if ledger:
1143                                ledger.append_entry(
1144                                    EvidenceEntry(
1145                                        task_id=task_id,
1146                                        agent_id="control_plane",
1147                                        action="stale_approval_detected",
1148                                        result=f"Repository drift detected: {drift_reason}",
1149                                        metadata={"drift_reason": drift_reason},
1150                                    )
1151                                )
1152                            raise StaleApprovalError(
1153                                f"Repository state has drifted since approval was granted ({drift_reason}). "
1154                                f"Approval is STALE. Re-review and re-approval required."
1155                            )
1156
1157                    # Check if this task requires bounded consequential execution
1158                    exec_boundaries = [b for b in decision.boundary_triggers if b in EXECUTABLE_BOUNDARIES]
1159                    if not exec_boundaries and task_spec.human_approval_requirements:
1160                        exec_boundaries = [b for b in task_spec.human_approval_requirements if b in EXECUTABLE_BOUNDARIES]
1161
1162                    receipt_file = run_dir / "execution_receipt.json"
1163
1164                    if exec_boundaries:
1165                        # Bounded consequential execution is required! Approval alone != Complete
1166                        if receipt_file.is_file():
1167                            try:
1168                                receipt = ExecutionReceipt.load_from_file(receipt_file)
1169                            except Exception as e:
1170                                raise InvalidReceiptError(f"Execution receipt at {receipt_file} is malformed: {e}")
1171
1172                            executor = (
1173                                ExecutorRegistry.get_executor(receipt.executor)
1174                                or ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(receipt.action_type)
1175                            )
1176                            if not executor:
1177                                raise InvalidReceiptError(f"Unknown executor '{receipt.executor}' in execution receipt")
1178
1179                            is_valid, val_reason = executor.verify_receipt(
1180                                receipt,
1181                                expected_action=receipt.action_type,
1182                                expected_repo=Path(target_repo).name,
1183                                expected_commit=current_fp.commit_sha,
1184                                run_dir=run_dir,
1185                            )
1186                            if not is_valid:
1187                                raise InvalidReceiptError(f"Execution receipt verification failed: {val_reason}")
1188                        else:
1189                            # Infer the consequential actions to execute
1190                            proposed_actions = infer_proposed_actions(
1191                                objective=task_spec.objective,
1192                                repo_name=Path(target_repo).name,
1193                                human_approval_requirements=decision.boundary_triggers,
1194                            )
1195                            if not proposed_actions:
1196                                primary_b = exec_boundaries[0]
1197                                proposed_actions = [
1198                                    ProposedAction(
1199                                        action_type=primary_b,
1200                                        target_repo=Path(target_repo).name,
1201                                        authority_boundary=primary_b,
1202                                        risk_level="critical" if primary_b in ("infrastructure_apply", "destructive_database_change") else "high",
1203                                    )
1204                                ]
1205
1206                            for action in proposed_actions:
1207                                executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(action.action_type)
1208                                if action.executor_id and not executor:
1209                                    executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor(action.executor_id)
1210
1211                                if not executor or not executor.is_available() or not executor.supports_action(action.action_type):
1212                                    raise UnsupportedActionError(
1213                                        f"AUTHORIZED ACTION CANNOT EXECUTE: No configured bounded executor supports '{action.action_type}'. "
1214                                        f"Task cannot complete without trusted bounded execution."
1215                                    )
1216
1217                                # Resolve or evaluate decision_id
1218                                decision_id = action.decision_id or decision.changeops_decision_id
1219                                if not decision_id:
1220                                    verdict, dec_id, eval_reason = executor.evaluate(action, target_repo, run_dir)
